crime: One girl kept taking over {WITCH_NAME}'s chores, telling the others she could not cope with clearing tables, sweeping, or fetching deliveries. Soon no one trusted her with a task. At dinner the girl even took the tray from her hands and carried it to her seat.

The next morning, {WITCH_NAME} waited beside the foot of the stairs leading to the cells. As the girl stepped over the first stair, she showed her the whole fall in a sudden vision. The girl recoiled with her weight already forward, lost her balance, and fell down the flight to her death.

The prisoners had called the feeling near {WITCH_NAME} a strange chill. Asked about it afterward, they described seeing disaster just before a risky movement, always under her gaze. The girls at the stairs had seen her watching the victim at the instant she recoiled. The fall had begun with the same frightened movement.
fields.epitaph: She could show anyone an ending, but never take her own first step.
execution: A platform stood above a deep pit, with sturdy plank bridges leading to safe ledges around it. She looked from one bridge to another without taking a step. The platform dropped, and she fell to the bottom. Every bridge remained in place.

magic.name: the Worst Case
magic.text: She can show someone the worst possible outcome of an action they intend to take.
